objects.description: During the [C0032](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0032) campaign, [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) used Mimikatz and a custom tool, SecHack, to harvest credentials.(Citation: FireEye TRITON 2019)
